scope: All parsed CEPROF frames, CPU/GPU events, counters and measurements for the four timeline datasets; all decoded CPU/ETW and GPU timeline datasets. ETL binary contents outside the exported timeline are not represented.
integerPolicy: JSON integer tokens retain original arbitrary precision; use an integer-aware parser for uint64 values, not JavaScript Number.

schema.captureFrameCollections: Events and measurements are column arrays; columns in each frame file define exact original object keys. Other frame keys are retained verbatim.
schema.timelineReconstruction: Each dataset field is loaded from fields[key].files; concatenate arrays in order only when concatenate=true. No fields are omitted.
